[edit | edit source]
Sainte-Marie collegial studies centre.
The Province of Quebec awards a Diploma of Collegial Studies for two types of programs: two years of pre-university studies or three years of vocational (technical) studies. The pre-university programs, which take two years to complete, cover the subject matters which roughly correspond to the additional year of high school given elsewhere in Canada in preparation for a chosen field in university. The technical programs, which take three-years to complete, applies to students who wish to pursue a skilled trade.

value.text:
Cégep Beauce-Appalaches is a public CEGEP in Saint-Georges, Quebec, Canada, within the Chaudière-Appalaches region. Its establishment is dated to 1968. Its historical origins are described separately as a merger of several institutions that became public in 1967, when Quebec created its CEGEP system. The college’s listed address is 1055, 116e rue in Saint-Georges, and its campus is described as urban.

The college belongs to Quebec’s collegial education sector, whose Diploma of Collegial Studies encompasses two-year pre-university programs and three-year technical programs. The pre-university route prepares students for university study, while technical studies prepare students for skilled work. A Sainte-Marie collegial studies centre is also mentioned in its program description. For 2025, the institution’s recorded employee total was 709; the statistical basis is unspecified.
